motivation: Distinguish source-record restoration from spatial-design refitting, because historical common centers and M geometry were constructed from source-blind pooled occurrence positions.
prior_outcome: original signed Level A 12 taxa 283/288 evaluable, 0/12 with q95 exceedance, conditional on 9705-file historical S3 object set
original_frame_source: 2026-09 signed core19 47-successor plus 12-heldout M=150/300/500 each 2000 source-blind comparison-row IDs
primary_estimand: What happens to full source-mode-fitted relative suitability and q95-calibrated heldout agreement when only missing source occurrence rows are restored while background rows, predictor values, M geometry, spatial block centers, procedure library and modeling code are fixed?
primary_gates: Exactly 47 original reference taxa and 12 original heldout taxa, no replacement.

For each taxon first reconstruct original 9705-file source input, 0.05-degree thin, source-blind pooled geometry and 12 original KMeans unit-sphere block centers; SHA-256 of float64 centers MUST match original core19 qualification receipt common_block_centers_sha256.

Recompute historical original predictions from 9705-file source using same original CHELSA 19 predictors, same historical centers and original signed frozen M-specific 2000-row frame; compare to original signed prediction surfaces using locked numerical tolerance and fail closed on unexpected differences.
Recompute repaired 10215-file source raw/quality/collision/thin, assign repaired presences to ORIGINAL centers; do not recalculate centers from repaired records for the primary estimand.
Use original signed 2000-row frame for BOTH arms; never include source labels in shared background or choose different evaluation points for a mode.
Use all eight original procedures × M=150/300/500 and the original independent source adequacy gates.
Seal all 47 repaired reference and 12 repaired heldout model predictions and qualification results before recalibrating 24 procedure×M q95 ceilings.

Calibrate new q95 only from the fixed 47 repaired-source reference taxa (at least 30 adequate taxa per reference cell), and evaluate all 12 repaired-source heldout taxa once; unresolved/underpowered cells stay unresolved.
Compare 12 taxon-level original and repaired outcomes, and report all 288 cell states without formal independent holdout p-values.
secondary_estimand: Sensitivity of the whole source-blind study pipeline to repaired GBIF source, including changed pooled centers, M geometry, and re-sampled background under unchanged original random seed and spatial filters.
secondary_constraint: Do not compare individual Schoener D values on nonidentical comparison frames as if they were paired same-grid observations; if rebuilt, compare aligned per-taxon summaries and inspect support shifts.
explicit_claim_boundary: A sensitivity rerun on previously observed taxa and source modes is retrospective source-completeness robustness, not a new independent 12-taxon confirmation or a causal biology conclusion.
